summary: Issue #1751 model-trial slice 1/3: reassessment under current standards of the nine legacy-only GOD_4-route premises whose attempts cite docs/notes/modal-spine.md, verified legacy_only at baseline 19c3d6e17b921431314b310b3d9be4cbc7860943 (GOD_4 root 54 current, 185 legacy-only, 182 none). They form four groups, not one argument: stage-one frame and time bridges (Euclidean frame F2 62b4a40a; presence gives existence A1 85497562); the uniting-cause bundle for ca07cae9 (6b80cfe4, 58445bd6, 27d15954, fbee7f15) with the component premise b35ce743; the transfer maxim 376d6a5a; independence allows being-without 8ab3d114. Read: the whole stage-one part of the note, its rival table, stage-two audits, the 2026-11-12 reconciliation draft and the 2026-11-17 connected case; docs/notes/composition-causal-scope.md whole; section 2 of priority-independence-logic-support-investigation.md and the scope audit of god-existence-support-formula.md; the efficiency judgment of esse-cause-efficiency-1633.md; legacy attempts 356fd6f9, f3722322, 3e2d1595, c2ffef68, bc674a0b, ca49ceb8, d0831334, f2b3c229, b28aad0f, a4a689b4, c0c90cee, 1511d8a2, 520ea849, 040e3b4e, 9c05bc24 and 8ba4d04f; dossier and brief for all nine. Meanings fixed: NECESSARY_2 (NecessaryAt) on the Ontic profile with rigid individuals, frame profile reflexive and Euclidean at the selected world (not S5); tenseless ever-history ExistsAt for A1; Unites, EfficientlyCausesIn and CausesIn at esse kept apart; inclusive IN_ACT_3; counterfactual D and modal B as separate primitives. First grades: 6b80cfe4 and b35ce743 strong prima facie; A1 strong as a stipulated tenseless reading, with present existence an unassessed bridge. Unchanged standings: F2 a positively motivated direct option, ungraded, with parallel burdens against the non-Euclidean rival (the arrivals need only F2' 1b1462e6); 58445bd6 moderate with restricted independent support; fbee7f15 restricted positive support, load-bearing in all five bundles for ca07cae9; 27d15954 conditional, ungraded and dispensable (transcription-only derivations from unassessed calibrations); 376d6a5a ungraded pending the unregistered power-versus-substantive eminence fork; 8ab3d114 unsupported in unrestricted form and avoidable. Objections: kept 4 (immanent constitution against fbee7f15; whole-first composition as partial against the reason for 58445bd6; departed composer against 27d15954 and instrument against unrestricted 376d6a5a, both conditional on a meaning choice); restated 10; boundaries retained 3; no substantive objection identified for 6b80cfe4, b35ce743, strong emergence and the prime-matter lead. Countermodels are restated as facts about single frames or interpretations. New analyst observations, unregistered and not Lean-checked: the instance y = x of 8ab3d114 commits its holder to reflexive D given that nothing can be while it is not, which meets the checked incompatibility cec081d8; 2c0b9bd7 with 67aa5b5c gives back 376d6a5a classically. No theorem, Challenge, claim, definition, relation, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared.
blocker: Open, unchanged: world-independent admissibility and cross-world identity for F2, against the origin-tolerance rival's own undischarged burden; whether later stages need present rather than tenseless existence (A1), and the co-presence question for inclusive IsAt; a numerically distinct concurrent giver of esse for fbee7f15 (the 2026-11-17 same-source test); the tense of Unites and the calibrations 1ad18c70, 8e44a618 and db54a1a6 for 27d15954; the eminence fork and the unread instrument reply for 376d6a5a; an actual-domain separation construction or a warranted identification of D with modal prerequisite for 8ab3d114. Next test: certify the diagonal of 8ab3d114 with an explicit irreflexivity postulate for CanBeWithout and compose it with the premises of cec081d8.

current_assessment.scope: Modal-spine legacy cluster: the nine open GOD_4-route premises whose legacy attempts cite docs/notes/modal-spine.md. Stage-one frame and time bridges (62b4a40a, 85497562), the uniting-cause bundle for ca07cae9 with the component premise (6b80cfe4, 58445bd6, 27d15954, fbee7f15, b35ce743), the transfer maxim 376d6a5a and independence-to-separability 8ab3d114. The 2026-11-17 connected pure-actuality assessment (383d23ad) keeps its own scope.
current_assessment.assessment: Under the fixed meanings (NECESSARY_2 on the Ontic profile, reflexive and Euclidean at the selected world, not S5; tenseless ever-history existence; uniting, efficient causing and causing esse kept apart; inclusive IN_ACT_3; counterfactual D and modal B separate) the nine premises do not stand or fall together. 6b80cfe4 and b35ce743 are strong prima facie with no objection on file; A1 85497562 is strong as a stipulated tenseless reading, at the cost that the stage-one conclusion is tenseless and present existence is an unassessed bridge. F2 62b4a40a is a positively motivated direct option, ungraded: its only rationale on file (absolute admissibility) rests on unassessed inputs and assumes what the non-Euclidean rival denies, so the burdens are parallel, as on 2026-11-14; the arrivals need only F2' 1b1462e6. In the uniting-cause bundle fbee7f15 is the load-bearing step in all five registered bundles for ca07cae9; it has restricted positive support, no stating source, and immanent constitution is kept against it. 58445bd6 is moderate with restricted independent support; 27d15954 is conditional, ungraded and dispensable. Unrestricted 376d6a5a and 8ab3d114 have no independent warrant on file and are avoidable through weaker registered versions or bypasses. Kept objections: 4 (immanent constitution; whole-first composition as partial; departed composer and instrument, each conditional on a meaning choice). Restated: 10; boundaries retained: 3. Countermodels are facts about single frames or interpretations. No earlier weighting is changed and no revision is declared; nothing is established or defeated.
current_assessment.next_test: Certify the diagonal of 8ab3d114: register irreflexivity of CanBeWithout as an explicit meaning postulate, derive not-not D(x,x) from it and 8ab3d114, and compose with the premises of cec081d8 (56252cd8, 2e248016, 7a63a3fe, 47aff057). A verified composition shows that packages keeping 8ab3d114 with the last three exclude every actual concretum and must give one up, for instance by using a8298fbd; a failure fixes what CanBeWithout means on the diagonal. For the uniting-cause bundle the 2026-11-17 same-source test stays the next test.
